call_sites_note: The change is a static evidence HTML fragment with no runtime code path; none found.

findings.summary: The done_when names a first census run at the base commit (893e18cc82) as the control reporting the 21 plans of §1, but no census was run at that revision; the fragment compares against §1's quoted meta figures instead, and the only census log is at f0bc4bc9d5e4, so the base arm is unmeasured here. It is non-blocking because the §2 closable readiness the census calls does not exist at the base revision, making a literal base-arm run impossible.
findings.text: The done_when's base-commit control census was never run; the fragment substitutes §1's quoted figures, so the before arm is not measured by this node.

findings.summary: The run directory carries control/control.log reading plans_scanned=0, the abandoned fixture control that scanned nothing, while the actual classifier control is the --self-check whose five-row output exists only in the run stream and no named log; a reader opening the control artefact sees a null measurement and the manifest's self-check claim is not backed by a log on disk.
findings.text: census-out/control/control.log records plans_scanned=0 (an empty control), and the real --self-check output is not persisted to a named log.

item_verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit over 893e18cc..03e4a0ed; four commits, one new 132-line evidence fragment, no product or test change.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when requires the census to report no unclosed/unstated 100% plan and no blocked-on-finished-gate plan, with a base-commit control reporting §1's 21 plans; census-final.log gives violations=16, blocked=0, and no base-commit census arm exists.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is '§6 — Every finished plan is closed or kept open for a stated reason' (prompt.txt:38); the landed fragment records a census that leaves 16 plans open with nothing stated, so the goal is documented as qualified, not delivered.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; the reviewed manifest records status complete, tests = the census command, test_logs = census-final.log, a reconciling artifacts summary and all six rubric lines.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Declared paths are the s6 evidence fragment and a figures dir; the diff touches only docs/evidence/fragments/a-finished-plan-closes/a-finished-plan-closes-s6.html.

justifications.durability: No test or committed instrument guards the census predicate: census_closable.py lives only in the run directory and will not survive run-directory collection, so the measure is not reproducible from the repository.
justifications.evidence: census-final.log reports 18 mounts, 226 plans, finished_open=17 violations=16 stated=1 blocked_on_finished_gate=0 and census.json reconciles, but no census at the base 893e18cc exists as the done_when's control arm.
justifications.fit: The fragment follows the sibling evidence template (meta docs-project/reckon-type/plan-verifies, article.r-note, data-node) at docs/evidence/fragments/a-finished-plan-closes/a-finished-plan-closes-s6.html:1, matching closable-readiness.html.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-finished-plan-closes/a-finished-plan-closes-s6.html:96 states the section's target is not met, so the section goal (§6: every finished plan closed or kept open for a stated reason) is recorded but not achieved.
justifications.reuse: The fragment adds no code; it consumes roadmap readiness, closure_blockers and deferred_remainder rather than re-parsing declarations, and the diff forks no repository capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: The whole diff is the single declared evidence fragment (git diff --stat: 1 file, +132), with the census script and logs kept in the run directory.
